decided: When the repository has no remote orbit can push to, the end of a command says the push was dropped only if pushing was turned on. If only committing was turned on, the commit happens and nothing is said about pushing.
alternatives: say the push was dropped whenever no remote is found, even when pushing was never turned on
why: A note about a push the user never asked for would be noise, and the two settings are separate so that each act is reported only when it was granted.
